photos.title: Photos Studio
photos.start.title: Open a photo
photos.start.body: JPEG and PNG originals. Edits render a copy in the background; your original file is never changed.
photos.start.drop: Or drop a photo anywhere in the window.
photos.unsupported.title: Photos cannot develop this file
photos.unsupported.body: The develop engine reads JPEG and PNG only (no transparency, up to 16 MP). {name} is {mime}. Open it in the Code studio instead.
photos.error.unsupported: This develop engine reads JPEG and PNG only, not {mime}.
photos.error.size: Develop input must be between 1 byte and {max} MB.
photos.error.notReady: The photo is not ready yet.
photos.compare: Hold to compare with the original
photos.crop.hint: Drag inside the frame to move it, drag a corner to resize.
photos.export.hint: Copies are capped at 2048 px, 8-bit sRGB, metadata removed
photos.discard: Discard session-only Photos edits to {name}? Export a copy to keep them.
photos.note: Settings stay in this session. A copy export is capped at 2048 px, 8-bit sRGB, with metadata removed. The original is never overwritten.
